article.story: LAKE CHARLES, La. -- — Larry Johnson scored 24 points and grabbed 10 rebounds to help McNeese beat Nicholls 94-68 on Monday night. DJ Richards hit four 3-pointers and scored 20 for the Cowboys (14-3, 7-1 Southland Conference), adding three steals. Tyshawn Archie went 5 of 10 from the field (1 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 13 points. Christian Winborne had 17 points and five assists to lead the Colonels (8-9, 7-1), who saw a five-game winning streak end. Zee Hamoda had 11 points and three steals, while Trae English added 11 points, five assists and four steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
